verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is an API-first product. Its docs describe async transcription, a WebSocket streaming API, a synchronous HTTP request-response endpoint, an API reference spec, and Python/TypeScript SDKs. A probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on API authentication and endpoint-level reference detail in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Transcribes audio up to 20 minutes long over HTTP ... in a single request-response call — no polling or webhooks needed.
Handles live audio over WebSocket with ~150ms p50 latency
Gives unified access to frontier language models through the same API
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://www.assemblyai.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
add ?excludeSpec=true to skip the API reference.
